description:
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Illusionist's Stratagem, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Illusionist's Stratagem, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
